thresholds.note: Thresholds are the 60th/85th percentile of calibrated predicted risk on a held-out calibration split (capped at 0.30/0.70): prob < low_max => LOW, < medium_max => MEDIUM, else HIGH; prob >= critical_min (smallest distinct calibrated value above the HIGH cut flagging <=5% of the calibration cohort) additionally flags CRITICAL. Probability thresholds targeting 80% recall would flag ~50% of patients at 3% prevalence, so percentile bands are used instead; per-band precision/recall are in metrics.json.
